details.publicNotes:
Venopaths, so named for their ability to telepathically inject venomous thoughts into the minds of others, are dangerous cavern-dwellers found in small communities deep underground. Their bodies are mostly hollow and humanoid-shaped, with tough, sinewy strands forming a cage-like structure around several dark, alien organs. Atop their bodies, their dark skulls barely contain their bulging brains.

Venopath communities tend to be relatively small, often only 6 to 8 members, since high concentrations of their corrosive thoughts indiscriminately kill most nearby creatures. Though venopaths have no regard for the lives of other species, they have no desire to waste potential food.

While they are cooperative within their small circles, venopaths reflexively despise outsiders. This hatred allows them to be prepared to defend their homes with deadly toxins at a moment's notice. Individual venopaths rarely step out of line, even in non-venopath organizations, as doing so in a community of their own people could result in group disapproval literally eating their brain from within.

Young venopaths must mature quickly, as venopath parents rarely allow their offspring to remain a part of their group for more than a few years. Though parents might not overtly contribute to their children's lives after this point, underground dwellers who attempt to prey on the newly exiled rarely survive the experience.

Public Menace

Confident in their ability to destroy any sentient creatures who cross them, venopaths don't make particular efforts to hide their presence from nearby prey. A venopath on an errand might walk calmly right through a nearby settlement, seemingly ignoring the consternation it causes—but marking particularly fearful or hostile onlookers as future dinners.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 64/140/250 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (slashing), perception item, skill items (Acrobatics, Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, Occultism)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, charisma, energy resistant (vitality), mind, mind shield, poison, poisonous armor, sensory (darkvision), throwing, wild, wisdom

Trigger A creature uses a mental effect on the venopath, attempts to communicate telepathically with the venopath, or attempts to read the venopath's mind

Effect The venopath deals @Damage[5d6[poison]] damage to the triggering creature with a @Check[will|dc:26|basic] save. The damage increases to @Damage[8d6[poison]] if the creature attempted to read the venopath's mind.

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:26]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[mental],1d6[poison]] damage, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[mental],2d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d6[mental],3d6[poison]] damage, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} (1 round).

The venopath chooses a creature within 30 feet and fills its thoughts with toxic imagery. The venopath attempts an @Check[intimidation|against:will] check against the target's Will DC.

Critical Success The target takes @Damage[6d8[poison]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Success The target takes @Damage[3d8[poison]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Toxic Intimidation for 1 hour.
